about: Boann's Lake Delhi 2010 baseline for boann_gate.py: the observed breach (as_observed.json) at the case's 30 m cell, run with the CPU build of the GPU kernels (bit-identical to one core; GPU == CPU is metal-engine.yml's gate). Differences are model minus surveyed over the 8 USGS high-water marks below the dam (OFR 2011-1301 table 8). Recorded 2026-11-22 from DWR_Plugins main 3f536222 (Runner 3.42.0) in the cloud. Re-record when an accuracy change is meant to move these numbers, and say so in the PR. boann_subfv added 2026-11-22 from main 1974df1f + the gate (Runner 3.43.0, before the sub-grid FV peak-velocity fix, which does not move water levels), r = 4, 34,116 steps, volume error 16.8 m3. boann_subli added 2026-11-23 with the solver (Runner 3.79.0, Boann 5.3.0): sub-grid local inertial at its default r = 4 (120 m cells keeping their 30 m sub-cells), flux weighting off (its default); with the weighting on the same run scored +1.88 ft mean, 1.88 ft mean size, 3.69 ft largest.
